Delivered items:
1) redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf — Redwood SOC 2 Type II (attached)

3) Audit logs & data retention answers (brief):
   - Audit logs: We retain request and access logs for 13 months by default; logs are stored in encrypted S3 with strict IAM controls and immutable write-once configuration for retention windows.
   - Access controls: Role-based access, MFA for all admin access, and privileged actions are logged and reviewed quarterly.
   - Data deletion: Customer-managed keys optional; account termination triggers a secure data deletion workflow within 30 days unless otherwise specified in contract.
